descriptions.zh: 如果我们不采取措施，我们对[Target.GetName]的竭泽而渔会让当地成为一个死寂星球。我们必须决定对这个议题抱持什么态度：我们是要改变做法，还是说当下的情况是可接受的——甚至是期待中的——工业化进程中的代价？
descriptions.en: If we take no action, our exploitation of [Target.GetName] will rapidly render it a Tomb World. We must decide where we stand on this issue: will we have to change our ways, or is this an acceptable - or even desirable - price of industrial progress?

descriptions.zh: 教团由我们星球的首位统治者在数个世纪之前成立，其目的只有一个：孜孜不倦地追寻毒圣的踪迹。自教团创建以来，发生了许多改变，但教团以及誓言试炼仍然留存了下来，其目的就是自我们母星最渺小的角落，到星系最遥远的地处，将整个世界意义寻遍。
descriptions.en: Founded centuries ago by the first ruler of our world, the Order has one purpose: to search tirelessly for the Toxic God. Much has changed since its creation, but the Order lives on as does its Quest, to search from the smallest corner of our home world to the farthest reaches of the galaxy.
